::: {#def-fwer}
#### Family-wise error rate

For a family of tests with $V$ false positives (@def-rejection-counts),
the **family-wise error rate** (FWER) is the probability of at least one false positive [@wikipedia_family_wise_error_rate]:

$$\text{FWER} \eqdef \Prf{V \ge 1}.$$

Source: @wikipedia_family_wise_error_rate.
:::
